messages.subject: Re: Prepare Mplus Data
messages.body_plain:
Hi Elisa,

If it’s just a matter of visual display, I would encourage you to open the file in Excel or OpenOffice. Mplus uses a text-based format, so getting a nice visual display is not really possible in a simple text editor. Or were you saying there is an error in the column structure of the file?

Best,
Michael
